title: W. R. Brooks obituary
text:
W. R. Brooks

SAVOY—Funeral services were held at 2 p.m. Monday in the Methodist Church, Savoy, for W. R. Brooks, 81, a retired farmer of Savoy, who died at 12:10 p.m. Sunday in a Bonham rest home, after a long illness.

The Rev. M. E. Fairchild, pastor, conducted the services. Burial was in Sunnyside Cemetery, directed by Earnheart Funeral Home, Whitewright.

Mr. Brooks was born April 4, 1877 in Lampases. He was a member of the Methodist Church.

Survivors are nieces and nephews.
notes: Bottom of clipping slightly cut off; last line reads 'phews.' — presumed 'nephews.'
